correctness.rationale: For ordinary geometric Q=|Δ_(4,7)|/D7 with rows fixed and dihedral group on columns, independently generated all rook placements to get face counts (28,252,840,840) and complete orbit barycentric flag counts (142,1236,2520,1440). Rank-preserving flags prohibit orientation reversals. Inspected VERIFY.py computing integer orbit boundary, d²=0, 141+1095+1422 integral unit-pivot cancellations, residual C=(1,0,3,18) and three Smith factors 2,2,2, so H2=(Z/2)^3, H3=Z^15. Original Δ(4,7) is 2-connected by the standard chessboard connectivity bound, and reflections (each fixes four vertices) generate D7, so Armstrong gives pi1(Q)=0. For a simply connected 3-dimensional CW complex, two-skeleton is a 2-sphere wedge and Smith form diagonalizes 3-cell attaching maps in pi2, giving exactly 3 M(Z/2,2)∨15 S3. Independent Euler check χ(Q)=−14 agrees with H3 rank15. Full integral cancellation was checked by reading algorithm and outcome but not separately rerun; independent flag enumeration confirms all input cell counts.
